segments.text: We first tried Customer Relationship Management (CRM) in 209. At the time, customer demand mattered because competitors moved online and took some market share.
The biggest issue was Access to finance. Without steady power in Abuja, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Customer Relationship Management (CRM)—we saw Better cashflow visibility within 6 months.
Policy-wise, Import duty waivers shaped our move. We adjusted by Pilot then scale.
Data helped; even a Excel-based trendline gave us clearer demand patterns during Christmas.
